title: Optional deterministic ECDSA
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 13. Reference script; RFC 6979 Deterministic ECDSA.

statements.label: Optional deterministic ECDSA
statements.requirement: The software ES256 signer in the testkit SHOULD support RFC 6979 deterministic nonces so that issued test artefacts can be reproduced byte for byte. Verifiers SHALL accept any valid ECDSA signature.

sources.quote: regenerates the example above byte for byte
